body:
Just for some background, the variable used to be `Set` (which I assume kept insertion order / sorted automatically like `RBSet`, and was changed to `RBSet` 5 years later (maybe around when `Set` was removed?). Then it was changed to `HashSet` when that got added, only for this to be reverted 3 years later to `RBSet` to fix the log rotation order.

Exchanging `RBSet` for `LocalVector` makes sense in principle. But `RBSet` does have a guarantee that there are no duplicate entries. 
Logically, I can't see how that would be relevant when listing files in a folder. But I also don't feel comfortable approving this, since there is no practical motivation behind this PR other than to exchange an old type for a new one.
